info.title: Connectivity and internal app foundation
info.description: Feature-disabled local health remains unauthenticated. Vercel and app-enabled local mode require the technical bearer on all non-preflight requests. Opt-in /v1/app operations additionally require a verified current user token. No public bootstrap/password API. FE generated consumer updates and production schema-changing delivery are separately coordinated.

200.description: Liveness
Ready

get.description: Owner-only local persisted status. Zero provider requests or refresh.

200.description: Local status

get.description: Current active Owner only; rechecks current session/membership before returning. Exactly one explicit app-key-only findShops page, no OAuth, redirects, retries, automatic pagination or lifecycle writes. Raw query is at most1024 bytes, decoded once; duplicate/unknown keys, query arrays, body and noncanonical path/method are rejected. Caller supplies a shop name, never a URL or shop ID. Provider deadline1500ms includes the at-most64KiB body; whole application operation8s includes Auth/DB with parent cancellation and existing shorter DB budgets. Private, no-store. A lookup never proves ownership or creates a connection.

parameters.name: shopName
parameters.description: Trim surrounding ASCII whitespace, then require1–64 ASCII alphanumeric characters and normalize lowercase. Raw Etsy URLs are invalid; FE owns any local URL-to-name parsing.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Canonical decimal only; one caller-selected page, never automatic pagination.

200.description: Bounded unverified candidate page; exact is safe only for a complete first page with one distinct exact-name candidate. Partial/later pages never establish absence or automatic selection.

429.description: upstream_rate_limited; existing per-app cooldown only. Bounded Retry-After and retryAfterSeconds1–86400, default60 for unusable upstream values; no retry.

503.description: configuration_unavailable for missing/invalid app configuration or definitive app-key rejection; dependency_unavailable for internal Auth/DB; upstream_unavailable for provider transport/timeout/redirect/size/schema failures. No upstream bodies, headers or credentials are exposed.

Durable receipt; shareUrl appears only on first acknowledged creation
Local cancellation receipt

post.description: Explicit Owner sync: getMe, bound getShop and at most one durable refresh. Never background polling.

200.description: Fresh verified four-field projection

post.description: Exact configured API/callback Host and invitation Origin only. Technical bearer is checked before the bounded body or invitation proof; no app membership required. Maximum8KiB JSON. Recipient confirmation and same-origin BFF are separately FE-owned.

303.description: One bound Etsy consent navigation; private/no-store/no-referrer

get.description: Exact configured Host/raw path only; single-use transaction-authenticated callback. Success query is exactly state+code; denial is state+error with optional error_description/error_uri. Maximum4096 bytes; duplicate and unknown fields rejected. No public status or confirmation page.

PreviewAccess.description: Separate private64-lowercase-hex technical key; required in Vercel and whenever app foundation is enabled locally. Never browser-visible.

AppAccessToken.name: X-App-Access-Token
AppAccessToken.description: Server-forwarded Supabase user JWT, independently verified against fixed issuer/JWKS/current session and membership. Never substitute the technical bearer.

Unauthorized.description: Generic Vercel denial before database work.

AppUnauthorized.description: Invalid technical key or user authentication/session.

AppConflict.description: Revision, invitation, ownership or idempotency conflict.

AppUnavailable.description: Dependency unavailable or outcome uncertain; do not blindly retry delivery.

shopId.description: Lossless positive decimal int64, at most9223372036854775807; never a JavaScript number.

shopUrl.description: Locally derived from validated shopName; never an upstream URL.

providerCount.description: Lossless nonnegative decimal int64, at most9223372036854775807.

complete.description: True only when offset0 covers the entire declared result set after strict validation; identical duplicates may collapse, conflicting same-ID names fail.

hasMore.description: Compare providerCount against offset plus original result-window length before deduplication.

nextOffset.description: offset+20 only when hasMore and below100, otherwise null.

truncated.description: More provider results exist but another fixed page would reach/exceed the100-candidate cap.

attemptPhase.description: Persisted consent/refresh phase; expired submitted work is reported unknown without reconciliation writes or provider requests

shareUrl.description: Secret invitation fragment; never retained in tables, logs or idempotency replays
